mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_versions (version_name, prompt_type, prompt_content, description, created_by) VALUES (#{versionName}, #{promptType}, #{promptContent}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_versions SET is_default = 0 WHERE prompt_type = #{promptType}
mapper.select: SELECT prompt_content FROM prompt_versions WHERE prompt_type = #{promptType} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM prompt_versions ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_ab_tests (test_name, prompt_type, version_a_id, version_b_id, created_by) VALUES (#{testName}, #{promptType}, #{versionAId}, #{versionBId}, #{createdBy})
